The wood grain texture is somewhat smooth and lacks fine detail, appearing slightly 'waxy' or painted-on rather than natural wood grain, particularly in the central vertical section.
The bottom metallic circle seems to lack a clear connection point or mounting hardware to the wooden body, appearing to float slightly or merge ambiguously with the wood.
